Evidence requirement: Specify intended users, configuration and the claim.
Proposed action: Define permitted/prohibited tasks and the fallback.

Evidence requirement: Observe behaviour, not referral text alone.
Proposed action: Test destination capacity and transfer completion.
Example metric: Completed handoffs; time to human contact

Evidence requirement: Specify comparator, endpoint and analysis population.
Proposed action: Separate chatbot, human and other intervention components.

Evidence requirement: Separate observed timings, extrapolation and full costs.
Proposed action: Measure work displaced/added and total implementation costs.
Example metric: Staff time; queue time; repeat contacts; total cost

Evidence requirement: Treat updates as possible changes to applicability.
Proposed action: Assign ownership, version control and stopping/scaling criteria.
Example metric: Incident resolution; update reviews; audit completion
